title: Joint Identified Regions for Probabilities of Benefit across Multiple Binary-Outcome Arms

That restriction, exponential evaluation, and the absence of inference or a substantive application constrain its leading-econometrics score, although the delivered identification geometry clears the field tier.

proof_attempt_summary: The derivation proved the minor-free total-variation criterion, exact signed subdivision characterization, clique and centered-K5 phase diagrams, sharp aggregate range, and fixed-order local-audit failure; both math and decision referees passed with no findings. The field-tier ambition collapsed only at the significance gate: higher-order general-graph results still require fair original-arm risks and use an exponential oracle. A re-raise would need genuinely new nonfair-margin polyhedral structure, efficient separation, or inference/application, rather than another revision of the present sound theorem package.
tldr: When binary arm risks are identified, separately sharp probabilities-of-benefit intervals need not be jointly selectable. This project characterizes when their Cartesian product is the simultaneous identified region. It proves a total-variation characterization on \(K_4\)-minor-free graphs, an exact signed subdivision oracle, and a coordinatewise complement bijection that extends the heterogeneous oracle from normalized risks to every \(r\in[0,1]^F\). The normalized half-cube has a finite irredundant facet and linear-feasibility description; the full-cube region is its coordinate-reflected preimage and need not be convex. On subdivided \(K_5\), risks in \([1/4,3/4]^{10}\) are rectangular exactly when the ten triangle sums and the aggregate sum, evaluated at \(\bar r_e=\min\{r_e,1-r_e\}\), obey the eleven stated inequalities. The project also proves the parity-sharp adjacent-order failure of every bounded-original-arm audit, with a strictly interior global witness. The mixed-risk contribution is an exact finite oracle, not a claimed concise uniform obstruction taxonomy.
gap: Existing causal work gives sharp scalar probability-of-benefit bounds, and Bernoulli, cut-polytope, and categorical-IV work gives global point-feasibility representations. ChagantyJoe2006 gives exact three-variable unstructured compatibility inequalities, structured one-parameter ranges, and a recursive arbitrary-dimensional point check. SongEtAl2026 Theorem 2 and Corollary 2 characterize pointwise compatibility of a specified full categorical potential-outcome law with a specified observed IV law. Neither source characterizes when every point of a sparse Cartesian product of pairwise Fréchet ranges is jointly attainable at fixed risks, especially beyond cycle geometry and under unequal subdivision risks.
fill: Prove the minor-free total-variation theorem with constructive witnesses, the exact signed subdivision criterion, sharp clique and \(K_5\) risk phase diagrams, and an arbitrary-order local-audit impossibility theorem with a sharp aggregate consequence; use the mixed-risk frontier as the main open extension rather than pretending the implicit signed oracle is already an interpretable classification.
